path: A folder JKNet needs is not available: {{path}}
state: JKNet lost track of its own state: {{reason}}. Restart the launcher.
archive: The archive could not be read: {{reason}}
image: The map picture could not be read: {{reason}}
signedOut: Sign in to JKNet to see your friends
engineFile: {{file}} belongs to the engine build, not to the library, so JKNet cannot switch it off or remove it.
basepathOccupied: {{path}} is a real folder, not the link JKNet keeps there. Move it away or delete it, then start the game again.
jkhubParse: A JKHub page could not be read: {{what}}. The site has probably changed.
archiveUnsupported: JKNet cannot open a .{{format}} archive yet.
noPk3Files: The archive holds no pk3 file: {{entries}}

online.notFound: JKNet Online does not know that account.
online.unauthorized: JKNet Online refused the session. Sign in again.
online.forbidden: JKNet Online does not allow that.
online.conflict: That name is taken. Type another one.
online.rateLimited: Too many requests to JKNet Online. Wait a moment and try again.
online.providerError: The sign-in provider is not available yet: {{message}}
online.internal: JKNet Online has a problem of its own. Try again later.
online.notConfigured: JKNet Online is not open yet, so this version keeps accounts and friends switched off.
